cards.title: Catalogue: the fatade3d.md catalogue structure, pages and pictures, in RC colours and design
cards.ask:
W29-01 catalog: exact copy of fatade3d.md catalog structure, pages and images, in RC colours and design
Source of record: https://fatade3d.md/categorie-produs/sisteme-de-termoizolatie/ and every category and product page reachable from their Catalog menu. Use headless Chrome, scroll each page fully, follow pagination, do not miss products. Acoperisuri and Garduri stay as they are (Imperlux source, do not touch). Copertine stays out of the Catalog.

1. STRUCTURE. Catalog categories, in this order, with sub-categories exactly as fatade:
Sisteme de termoizolatie -> Polistiren expandat, Polistiren extrudat, Vata minerala, Adezivi si mase de spaclu, Alte produse
Tencuieli decorative
Placi ceramice (rename our Placi flexibile to this, 301 redirect old slug)
Elemente decorative
Vopsele -> Vopsele de exterior, Vopsele de interior
Sisteme de iluminare
Alte materiale de constructii
plus our Acoperisuri and Garduri. Hub tile count stays 9, update catalog-counts test to the new category slugs and counts.

2. PAGES. Three levels like fatade:
a) Catalog hub: 9 tiles.
b) Category page: for categories with sub-categories, show sub-category tiles (image, name, "Vezi produse" button, optional TOP badge where fatade has it), NOT the product dump. For categories without sub-categories, show the product grid directly.
c) Sub-category page: product grid. Breadcrumb Acasa / Catalog / Category / Sub-category.
Product grid: 4 columns desktop, 2 tablet, 1 at 320px, cards fill rows, no half-page blank space. Card = image, brand logo small if fatade shows one, name, sizes or variants line, price or price range in MDL, our orange arrow button. Prices copied from fatade as shown; where fatade shows "0,00 lei" as the low end, show only the high value. Every product fatade has must exist on ours in the same category and sub-category and the same order. Product detail pages: same fields as fatade (name, variants, description, price), our design, "Solicita oferta" CTA instead of cart.
RU: use fatade's RU toggle for names and descriptions where available, translate only what fatade lacks.

3. IMAGES. Download every product, sub-category and category image from fatade3d.md at the largest resolution served, convert to webp plus fallback, store under public/images/catalog/<category>/<sub>/. Manifest row per image per R-W29-02. Replace all current fatade-group images on our side.
EXCEPTIONS (do not take from fatade):
- Polistiren expandat > "CT 80 F - Polistiren expandat": placeholder image (neutral grey EPS board, our existing stock is fine), product stays with its name, sizes and price.
- Alte materiale de constructii > Coltar PVC - FATADE 3D, Plasa de armare, Membrana de DIFUZIE pentru acoperisuri: keep our current images exactly as they are, no change.
All other images: fatade's, exactly.

4. MENU AND MOTION. Rebuild the Catalog mega menu to fatade's behaviour: left column of categories, hover or tap on a category with sub-categories opens a flyout panel to the RIGHT, aligned to the top of that row, same height as the row block, panel heading = category name, chevron on the row points right and stays right. Mobile: same, panel slides in from the right at the row's height, never upward. Measure fatade's transitions in headless Chrome (getComputedStyle transition-duration, timing-function, transform on menu open, on flyout open, on tile hover, on "Vezi produse" hover) and reproduce those values with our colours. Record the measured values in the report.

5. DO NOT: change Acoperisuri, Garduri, Copertine, service pages, home. Do not add cart, blog, promotions, "rate cu 0%" or any discount or financing string (R-X). Do not add review counts.

Acceptance:
- named test catalog-structure asserts the category and sub-category tree above in both locales, exit 0
- named test catalog-parity compares a committed docs/catalog/FATADE-PARITY.json (product name, category, sub-category, order, price, image source URL, scraped by you at run time and committed) against our rendered catalog in headless Chrome, zero missing products, exit 0
- named test catalog-images asserts every fatade-group product image src maps to a SOURCES.md row with the fatade licence string, and the 4 exceptions are exactly as specified, exit 0
- 320px gate, axe, Lighthouse catalog pages >= 90 performance
- catalog-counts updated and green
- screenshots in the report: hub, Sisteme de termoizolatie category page, Polistiren expandat sub-page, Vopsele flyout open desktop and mobile, one product detail page

Report to docs/reports/W29-RUN.md: per card status, PR numbers, deviations, the measured motion values, list of products copied per sub-category with counts, the 4 exceptions confirmed. End with documents-only board sync and artifact republish from main.
